The '''Guardian Mark II Droid''' was a model of [[Dog/Legends|canine]]-shaped [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]] developed by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]]. It was a variation of the famous [[GV/3-series guardian droid]].<ref name="GU12ET" />

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Guardian Mark II Droid appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TCOA">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Guardian Mark II Droid was added to the game with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Game Update 12|Game Update 12]], on [[August 10]], [[2009]].<ref name="GU12">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=976424|text=Game Update 12: Engineering Trader}}</ref> The droid was designed by artist [[Christine Chugon]].<ref name="drawkin">{{WebCite|url=http://drawkin.com/swg|text=Star Wars Galaxies - General 3D artist & UI|work=[[Christine Chugon]]'s official website|archivedate=20180822005115}}</ref>
